workstream: Production reliability and release engineering / learning PPT player arrow navigation

scope.issue: Bottom narration dock previous/next arrow buttons did not change the active published PPT slide.

rootCause.summary: The slide thumbnail rail was wired to activePublishedSlideIndex, but the bottom narration dock arrow buttons were static controls.
details: SlideChapterRail received onSelectPublishedSlide and called setActivePublishedSlideIndex(index).
NarrationDock received activePublishedSlide but did not receive activePublishedSlideIndex or previous/next handlers.
The bottom arrow buttons rendered aria labels but had no onClick handlers, so clicks never updated the active slide state or audio source.

changes: Added a failing regression test that clicks the bottom next and previous arrows and asserts the active published PPT audio source/page label changes.
Added previous/next handlers in LearningPage that update activePublishedSlideIndex with first/last slide clamping.
Passed activePublishedSlideIndex and previous/next handlers into NarrationDock.
Wired the NarrationDock arrow buttons to those handlers and disabled them at the first/last published slide.

localVerification.evidence: Clicking the bottom next arrow left the audio src on slide-01 instead of slide-02.
Next.js production build compiled, type checked, and generated static pages successfully.

evidence: Initial page showed heading 自然数的序数理论, stage page 1 / 19, bottom label 第 1 页 / 约 15.52 秒, and previous button disabled.
Clicking 下一段 changed the heading to 学习线索, stage page to 2 / 19, and bottom label to 第 2 页 / 约 14.56 秒.

After clicking 下一段, the audio element src was /api/learning/ppt-playback/audio/audio-manifest-elementary-math-research-natural-number-ordinal-theory-ppt1/tts_natural-number-ordinal-theory-ppt1_slide-02.
Clicking 上一段 returned the heading to 自然数的序数理论, stage page to 1 / 19, bottom label to 第 1 页 / 约 15.52 秒, and previous button disabled again.

remainingGoalBlockers: Production-grade trusted teacher auth/session provider is still not fully integrated.
External durable storage still needs the real service, Vercel env binding, and deployed smoke proof.
Manual PPT/WPS/PowerPoint playback acceptance is still not complete.
Full enterprise UAIS website teacher workflow remains to be proven end to end under the production auth/storage chain.
